mode: UTF-8, standard_conforming_strings on, pg_catalog first and stock Boolean operators and ordering.

BooleanColumnReference.role: One typed read of a native Boolean member of an owning table occurrence.
BooleanColumnReference.structure: The zero-based occurrence and slot identifying the exact Boolean field.
BooleanColumnReference.conditions: Coordinates are nonnegative. The owner must bind an existing bool slot of that occurrence.
BooleanColumnReference.meaning: Read true, false or NULL from this field, including when the selected join side supplies a NULL extension.
BooleanColumnReference.sql: Emit the controlled occurrence alias and the resolved field name for the ordered slot.

structure: A checked SELECT result or Boolean predicate reads a native bool position in an ordinary physical or independent derived relation. A predicate can use the field directly or compose it with NULL and truth tests. Scope and result ordering follow the owning query.
conditions: Close every scoped Boolean read over its typed occurrence. Unqualified and qualified readings of the same declared field share the same target coordinates. Reject missing or incorrectly typed Boolean slots before publishing a complete value.
meaning: A Boolean read produces the stored truth value or NULL. A filter keeps TRUE only. Truth and NULL tests follow PostgreSQL's three-valued semantics and return Boolean results. DISTINCT uses native Boolean equality including NULL duplicate handling. ORDER BY uses PostgreSQL's Boolean ordering and explicit NULL positions.
sql: Emit qualified field reads, preserve the operand and scope of each predicate, and emit exact projected field names and ordering positions.
observations: Ordered field labels, exact native bool type, resolved occurrence and slot
TRUE, FALSE and NULL, predicate effects, and outer join null extension
Multiplicity and DISTINCT, ordered result tuples, and the empty result descriptor

finite.completeness: Recover the exact native field, occurrence, source role, predicate, result order and multiplicity policy from the constructed graph and consume each distinct combination in both releases.

analysis: Unqualified and qualified names select the same bool field

exploration.requiredForms: Vary both physical fields, occurrence roles, nesting of supported truth tests and logical operators, projected labels and duplication, nullable rows, filter and order.
